## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Milán Horváth_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "The watch (GW8 Classic) measures VO2 Max perfectly, but the Samsung Health app UI is completely broken. The VO2 Max section is literally just labeled "Title" due to a missing string resource, and the description contains an unpopulated variable: "at least %s kilometres per hour". How does a basic "%s" formatting error slip past QA? Paying for premium hardware only to get this level of software polish makes me wish I had chosen Apple instead. Please fix your string templates!"
            2. _Leonids Pakrastins_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "The app, which wasn't very convenient or accurate in terms of heart rate and cerebral cortex monitoring, became completely unusable after the update. The next watch will be a Huawei one."
            3. _Jennifer Huls_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "loved this app until the latest update now it is buggy & really hard to find the information I need. i mainly use it to track my runs. every time i have used it for the last month there is something that doesn't work. 1st week I couldn't even use it on my watch took about an hour to figure out what the problem was, 2nd week I couldn't get it to sync with strava another hour to get that figured out. 3rd week took me forever to find my past runs. Today half the info like v02 max was missing. Why??"
<!--/ir-theme-->
